title: 'A lover of animals': French film icon Brigitte Bardot dies at 91
summary: French film legend Brigitte Bardot has died at 91, the Bardot foundation announced on Sunday (December 28). Bardot starred in more than 50 movies during her career before leaving the film industry to concentrate on animal rights activism. For more on that topic, FRANCE 24 is joined by Elora Thevenet, producer of "Bardot" documentary.
